purpose: A local Electron cockpit for driving and observing Claude Code CLI sessions, organized around a TAB (project) → EPIC (tagged claude session) → PRD (scheduled work item) hierarchy.
what: The core domain model is **TAB = project cwd**, **EPIC = one tagged claude session** (`state/promptSessions.ts`), and **PRD = scheduled unit of work** minted under an Epic via `lib/epicMint.cjs`. Chat and Terminal are two views over the same `claudeSessionId`, never two sessions — recent work (`2a986a0`, `7f250df`, `00b57bd`, `efb6a8e`) hardened this: live-streaming assistant bubbles/tool chips in the Epic thread, broadcasting scheduler response events into open threads, and resolving external-send targets against Epics rather than raw SessionTabs.

`scheduler.cjs` runs PRDs from each project's own `session-manager-operations/scheduler/epics/<epic-id>/prds/` as `claude -p` jobs, with boot reconciliation, a dead-process reaper, a definition-of-done drain gate, and a machine-wide ≤3-slot `claude -p` concurrency pool (`lib/sessionSlots.cjs`) shared by scheduler jobs and `chatRunner.cjs` chat runs.

The `EpicsWorkspace` renderer surface (retiring the legacy `TerminalChat`/Projects UI) was built out PRD-by-PRD through July: queue pane, detail pane, composer, mic dictation, token accounting, git branch header, chat↔terminal toggle, PRD/Runs tabs, and now live-streaming turns — this is the most actively churned area in the current git log.

A newer **Home/Brief** surface (`projectBrief.cjs`, `65ffe42`, `d0b36b6`) synthesizes a per-project summary (this very Brief) plus live Now/Waiting-on-you blocks and Active/Recent session cards for the redesigned per-project Home tab.

conventions: Tab ID = claudeSessionId; Epic mints its own claudeSessionId independent of any SessionTab's.
Chat and Terminal are mutually-exclusive views over one session — switching must hand off, never mint a new sessionId.
No cross-subscribing between zustand stores (config.ts, live.ts, voice.ts, scheduleState.ts, toast.ts) — compose in components.
Never return a freshly-built value from a zustand selector (causes React #185 blank-app); select raw slice, derive after. Enforced by `npm run lint:selectors`.
All fs paths go through config.cjs's validatePath (allowedRoots = home dir); atomic writes via tmp+rename helpers, never hand-rolled.
Cap at ≤3 concurrent `claude -p` jobs machine-wide (queue.json concurrencyCap) — prior 5x OOM-killed Electron.
New PRDs must mint/join an Epic via lib/epicMint.cjs or scheduler_create_prd MCP tool; never write to the retired flat scheduler/prds/.
Before adding a new LeftNav destination, check whether an existing surface (Terminal, Scheduler) already owns that data and extend it instead.
